STEP 1 - Scene: A single slice of pizza (or flatbread/tart-style slice) with a topping of soft white cheese or cream and fresh green herbs/arugula, on a white plate. Photographed from above, roughly top-down, with a glass/metal surface beneath.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The plate is round, about 26 cm in diameter (dinner plate). Its radius is 13 cm, so area ≈ 3.14 x 13² ≈ 530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: (1) pizza slice crust/base with tomato-sauce-like topping, (2) soft white cheese or cream dollop, (3) fresh green leaves (arugula-like).

STEP 4 - Area: The pizza slice is a wedge about 13 cm along its outer arc and about 10 cm deep, covering roughly 22% of the plate (~115 cm²). The white cheese covers about 3% (~15 cm²). Greens cover about 3% (~15 cm²). Total food ≈ 28% of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume: Pizza slice ~115 cm² x 1.2 cm ≈ 138 ml. Cheese ~15 cm² x 1.0 cm ≈ 15 ml. Greens ~15 cm² x 2 cm ≈ 30 ml (airy, will be light).

STEP 6 - Grams: Pizza slice 138 ml x 0.9 ≈ 124 g. Cheese 15 ml x 0.9 ≈ 14 g. Greens 30 ml x 0.15 ≈ 5 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Pizza with cheese and tomato, cooked: ~260 kcal/100 g → 124 g ≈ 322 kcal. Soft cheese/cream: ~300 kcal/100 g → 14 g ≈ 42 kcal. Arugula/leafy greens: ~25 kcal/100 g → 5 g ≈ 1 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A single pizza slice of about 120–150 g with a small amount of cheese and greens, roughly 350–400 kcal, is plausible for what is visible. Total ≈ 143 g, ≈ 365 kcal.
